title: Shadowrealm Beginner Tips: Your First Day in the Dark Realm
subtitle: What to do with your first energy, your first gold and your first stronghold build.
description: Shadowrealm beginner tips for the free dark fantasy browser RPG: energy, actions, jail protection, the stronghold and gear, in the order that saves time.
card: The first-day checklist for Shadowrealm: Age of Darkness, from energy and early actions to claiming your stronghold.

faq.q: How fast does energy regenerate in Shadowrealm?
faq.a: Energy regenerates 1 point every 5 minutes at the base rate, HP 1 point per minute and mana 1 point every 30 seconds. The bars keep refilling while you are logged out, so you lose nothing by leaving.

faq.q: Can I go to jail on my first actions?
faq.a: No. Your first 30 actions can never send you to jail, whatever the roll. After that a failed crime can jail you, and you either wait out the sentence or another player breaks you out.

faq.q: Should I claim the stronghold right away?
faq.a: Yes. You can claim the Forsaken Hold at rank 1, and it produces resources and gold even while you are offline. Start a build before you log off so the timer runs while you are away.
